title: pretty ELYAN|Plus Size Half Sleeve Pleated A-Line V-Neck Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Look effortlessly chic on your friend's big day with our Plus Size Half Sleeve Pleated A-Line V-Neck Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress. The flattering A-line silhouette and V-neckline accentuate your figure, while the pleated chiffon adds a touch of romance. Perfect for weddings and formal occasions, this dress will make you feel like a beautiful and supportive bridesmaid. (occasions: weddings, formal occasions, bridesmaid)


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Half sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
